title: Byte Engine motion database
description: A standalone motion database: the animation clips a matched state searches, and the features it compares them by.

$schema.description: The local JSON Schema reference for this asset.

clips.description: Clip asset IDs, fragment included, and `*` or `?` patterns that match source file IDs. Clips follow the order of their entries.

loops.description: Clip asset IDs and `*` or `?` patterns naming the clips of `clips` that loop. A looping clip's frames are all pickable, and its ground root continues into its next cycle.

root.description: The ground root: the node it projects onto the ground, and how much its motion is smoothed.

node.description: The node the ground root projects, usually the hips.

facing.description: The node whose yaw the ground root faces; the `node` when left out. Name a node that faces where the body faces, like the head, when the root node twists toward the travel, as the hips do in many strafes.

position_smoothing.description: The standard deviation, in seconds, of the Gaussian that smooths the ground root's position.

facing_smoothing.description: The standard deviation, in seconds, of the Gaussian that smooths the ground root's yaw.

sample_rate.description: The frames per second the database samples its clips at.

nodes.description: The node feature weights, by node name. Each node needs a positive weight.

position.description: The weight of the node's position feature.

velocity.description: The weight of the node's velocity feature.

trajectory.description: When the trajectory features sample and how much they weigh.

times.description: The times ahead of a frame, in seconds, that the trajectory features sample. Positive and strictly ascending.

position.description: The weight of the trajectory position feature.

direction.description: The weight of the trajectory direction feature.

search.description: How often a matched state searches and how it switches.

interval.description: Seconds between searches while a matched state plays.

exclusion.description: Seconds from the playing time within which frames of the playing clip aren't candidates.

blend.description: Seconds a switch to a found frame inertializes over.

halflife.description: How fast the predicted trajectory reaches the requested velocity and facing.

velocity.description: The halflife, in seconds, of the spring that moves the predicted velocity toward the requested one and predicts the trajectory's position from it.

facing.description: The halflife, in seconds, of the spring that predicts the trajectory's direction.
